name: frontend-linux-deployment
title: Frontend Linux same-origin deployment
description: Reconcile the latest upstream schema and deploy the standalone Web package with the Python API as separate services behind one Linux same-origin TLS proxy.
creator: codex
notes: Provider-neutral Debian/Ubuntu deployment artifacts and a same-origin release runbook are ready for review. Remote rollout was not attempted because no team domain, SSH host/user/auth path, or authorized server inventory exists in the repository or local SSH configuration. Real PostgreSQL migration rehearsal and target-host nginx/systemd validation remain external gates.
